summary:
Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the repository, but nothing was run: tests and repo code were off-limits, so the test_columns expected output rests on a hand trace of clock reads.

Changes:
- rich/progress.py: Task.finished_time field (after _get_time, before visible); finished is now "finished_time is not None"; _reset clears finished_time; update and advance capture elapsed after their bookkeeping when completed >= total and nothing is captured yet; reset clears finished_time before refresh; TimeElapsedColumn added between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn.
- rich/default_styles.py: progress.elapsed set to yellow.
- rich/palette.py: Palette.__rich__ returns a Table (title "Palette", caption "N colors" right-justified, highlight on), with columns index, RGB, Color. Table/Text/Style/Color imports are lazy; Table is imported only under TYPE_CHECKING. Headers "index", "RGB", "Color" are my choice.
- CHANGELOG.md: [Unreleased] section with an Added entry for Progress.TimeElapsedColumn.
- tests/test_palette.py (new): test_rich_cast, as specified.
- tests/test_progress.py: TimeElapsedColumn imported; new test_time_elapsed_column covering unstarted, running, and finished states via start_task, advance, and a non-auto MockClock; TimeElapsedColumn() added to test_columns after TimeRemainingColumn(), with expected output updated in the same session.

test_columns trace: read k returns k. Start-frame elapsed reads are c37 (foo, 37) and c47 (bar, 47 - 11 = 36). Capture reads c56 (bar, 45) and c60 (foo, 60). Finished frames show 0:01:00 and 0:00:45. Speed: foo 9/7 and bar 12/8 both show "1 byte/s". Bar widths are 25 unstarted and 16 finished (base 33 and 23, matching the layout model). Glyph counts were verified. Test-suite results are unverified: the unit test, palette test, and existing tests were not run. Read-only analysis suggests test_render, test_expand_bar, test_track, test_progress_track, test_reset, and test_progress_max_refresh are unaffected. Nothing was committed.
